evidence.title: Return from authorized Investigate Case Timeline and source to the originally selected Command Incident
evidence.goal: Close CAP-CMD-106 §17/§25 Class-0 Incident→Investigate→Incident navigation in the already runnable first-party local browser, without creating an authorization bridge, mutation, redirect, source store, new route or paid API.
outputs: Case Timeline HTML displays a single fixed Command Incident selection return link when safe origin is supplied; pagination retains this hint
Owner-authorized source HTML return carries the same inert Incident ID back to Case; Case provides an explicit Command return even after source view
Real HTTP test traverses Incident/Case/source/Timeline/Incident with separate synthetic owner decisions and fails closed for commander-only Case access
acceptance_tests: Command selected Incident link carries only opaque encoded selected Incident ID and currently authorized Case ID; never bearer/tenant/permission
Full browser-style HTTP journey goes from selected Incident to independently authorized Case, source, back to same timeline page, and back to freshly authorized selected Incident
Invalid/multiple/forged/overlong origin IDs, foreign Case, foreign endpoint, wrong owner, and JSON-origin hint must deny without partial content
Original Case page source filters/page preserved through optional origin; legacy no-origin Case/source links unchanged
Mandatory Timeline, Work Queue/Command host and Engineering CI pass on the exact candidate SHA, with no lowered guards

Legacy first-party Work Queue and Command host tests validate exact encoded Case+Incident HTML link while original strict JSON-originless client requests retain full old assertions and access boundary.

rules: Strict tenant isolation and permission checking
